name: Art Nouveau
description: Organic line, botanical forms, and decorative letterforms create a flowing, ornamental visual language.

sources.title: An Introduction to the History of Graphic Design

name: Art Deco
description: Geometric symmetry, stepped forms, streamlined ornament, and polished contrast evoke machine-age glamour.

name: Polish School of Graphic Design
description: Metaphorical imagery, expressive lettering, painterly color, and surreal visual compression.
referenceQueries: Polish School of Graphic Design design
Polish School of Graphic Design aesthetics

name: Japanese Modernism
description: Distilled symbols, precise typography, asymmetry, and generous open space.

name: Soviet Constructivism
description: Geometric forms, photomontage, diagonal energy, and utilitarian communication.

sources.title: An Introduction to the History of Graphic Design

name: Bauhaus
description: Functional geometry, primary colors, clear typography, and reduced forms.

sources.title: An Introduction to the History of Graphic Design

name: De Stijl
description: Rectilinear geometry, primary colors, and disciplined horizontal and vertical structure.

sources.title: An Introduction to the History of Graphic Design

name: Psychedelic Graphics
description: Vibrating outlines, dense ornament, fluid lettering, and saturated color.

name: Punk Graphic Design
description: Cut-and-paste textures, defiant typography, rough reproduction, and stark contrast.

sources.title: An Introduction to the History of Graphic Design

name: New Wave Graphics
description: Layered grids, fragmented typography, sharp color, and playful visual disruption.

sources.title: Design History: The New Wave of Graphic Design

name: Memphis Design
description: Playful geometry, squiggles, pattern clashes, and bright, pastel, or primary palettes.

name: Pop Art
description: Mass-media imagery, bold outlines, repetition, and commercial color.

name: Dada
description: Chance composition, collage, absurd juxtapositions, and anti-rational expression.

name: Futurism
description: Directional motion, dynamic diagonals, machine energy, and fragmented rhythm.

name: Suprematism
description: Floating geometric forms, pure color fields, and non-representational composition.

name: Vorticism
description: Angular abstraction, compressed movement, and industrial energy.

name: Orphism
description: Rhythmic circles, luminous color, and musical abstraction.

name: Rayonism
description: Intersecting rays and translucent planes suggest motion and fractured light.

name: Precisionism
description: Crisp industrial forms, simplified urban geometry, and clean edges.

name: Op Art
description: Optical patterns and calculated contrast create perceptual movement.

name: Kinetic Art
description: Repeated forms and visual rhythm imply or produce movement.

name: Abstract Expressionism
description: Gestural marks, open composition, and emotionally charged color.

name: Hard-Edge Abstraction
description: Flat color planes with sharply defined boundaries and little visible brushwork.

name: Color-Field Painting
description: Broad expanses of color create quiet, immersive compositions.

name: Lyrical Abstraction
description: Fluid marks, intuitive gestures, and flowing color relationships.

name: Neo-Expressionism
description: Raw imagery, assertive mark-making, and clashing or intense color.

name: Pop Surrealism
description: Polished fantasy imagery combines whimsical, uncanny, and pop-cultural motifs.

name: Fluxus Graphics
description: Playful instructions, everyday objects, and anti-hierarchical presentation.

name: Situationist Graphics
description: Détourned mass imagery and disrupted commercial signs carry critical intent.

name: Postmodern Graphic Design
description: Historical quotation, layered references, and playful typography.

sources.title: An Introduction to the History of Graphic Design

name: Flat-vector illustration
description: Crisp filled shapes and limited shading create a clean digital image.

name: Minimal line illustration
description: Sparse contours suggest form with very few marks.

name: Doodle illustration
description: Casual drawn marks and simplified figures feel spontaneous.

name: Conceptual editorial illustration
description: A metaphorical image makes an abstract subject immediately legible.

name: Anime visual style
description: Stylized characters, expressive eyes, and graphic color shape Japanese animation.

name: Manga visual style
description: Sequential storytelling, varied linework, and expressive character shorthand.

name: Chibi illustration
description: Small bodies and oversized heads exaggerate cute character expression.

name: Superflat illustration
description: Flat space and bold outlines connect pop imagery with graphic painting.

name: Kawaii illustration
description: Rounded forms, simplified faces, and sweet color express cuteness.

name: Ligne claire illustration
description: Clean outlines, flat color, and legible comic staging.

name: American comic-book art
description: Dynamic anatomy, ink contours, and sequential action.

name: Mid-century modern illustration
description: Simplified shapes, limited palettes, and playful retro figures.

name: Airbrush illustration
description: Smooth gradients and seamless blending create glossy, dreamlike surfaces.

name: Textured-vector illustration
description: Clean vector forms gain grain, paper, or brush texture.

name: Paper-cut illustration
description: Layered silhouettes and cast shadows imitate cut and stacked paper.

name: Halftone illustration
description: Dots and screens create tonal pattern and print-like texture.

name: Crosshatch drawing
description: Intersecting lines model shadow, volume, and texture.

name: Stipple illustration
description: Dots of varying density create tone and detail.

name: Scratchboard illustration
description: Scraped highlights cut through dark surfaces to define form.

name: Charcoal illustration
description: Smudged dark masses and soft marks create dramatic tonal range.

name: Colored-pencil illustration
description: Layered strokes and visible pigment give drawings a tactile finish.

name: Marker illustration
description: Broad saturated strokes create clean, fast, graphic color.

name: Screenprint aesthetic
description: Flat ink layers, visible overlaps, and constrained color separations.

name: Risograph print aesthetic
description: Grain, vivid spot colors, and slight registration shifts.

name: Letterpress aesthetic
description: Pressed type, raised ink, and textured paper.

name: Woodcut print aesthetic
description: Carved contours and bold light-dark contrast.

name: Linocut print aesthetic
description: Smooth cut marks and simplified relief shapes.

name: Etching print aesthetic
description: Fine incised lines and crosshatching build tonal depth.

name: Lithographic print aesthetic
description: Crayon-like marks and tonal washes transfer to paper.

name: Monotype print aesthetic
description: Singular, painterly impressions retain chance marks.

name: Cyanotype aesthetic
description: Prussian-blue imagery and white silhouettes create a distinctive print.

name: Photogram aesthetic
description: Objects placed on light-sensitive paper create direct shadows and shapes.

name: Paper-ephemera collage
description: Tickets, labels, letters, and found scraps form an archival image.

name: Xerox copy-art
description: High-contrast photocopy marks, noise, and repeated generations.

name: Zine aesthetic
description: Handmade layout, photocopy grain, and direct personal voice.

name: Stencil aesthetic
description: Repeated cut shapes and overspray create a street-print look.

name: Paste-up aesthetic
description: Layered paper images and torn edges suggest public wall culture.

name: Decoupage aesthetic
description: Decorative cutouts cover objects or surfaces in layered motifs.

name: Mixed-media assemblage
description: Found materials and image fragments are physically combined.

name: Ink-wash aesthetic
description: Fluid diluted ink and dry-brush marks balance softness and precision.

name: Gouache aesthetic
description: Opaque, matte color and crisp edges create a hand-painted illustration.

name: Watercolor-wash aesthetic
description: Transparent pigments and flowing edges produce a light surface.

name: Impasto painting
description: Thick paint ridges and saturated strokes make texture visible.

name: Pastel drawing
description: Powdery color and soft blending produce luminous, velvety surfaces.

name: Fresco-mural aesthetic
description: Broad matte color and simplified forms suit large public images.

name: Embroidery illustration
description: Stitches form contours, fills, and decorative image details.

name: Quilted-collage aesthetic
description: Fabric blocks and seams organize image, color, and pattern.

name: Beadwork graphic aesthetic
description: Tiny repeated units create ornamental motifs and sparkling surfaces.

name: Tapestry-inspired graphic style
description: Woven pattern, flattened scenes, and decorative borders.

name: Mosaic illustration
description: Small repeated pieces build figures, icons, or patterned fields.
